map.桩基础承载力计算 使用指南: Pile foundation bearing capacity calculation user guide
map.桩基础承载力计算器，按侧阻与端阻经验公式求单桩竖向承载力特征值并估算桩数，辅助桥: Pile foundation bearing capacity calculator: by empirical formulas of side resistance and end resistance, find the characteristic vertical bearing capacity of a single pile and estimate pile count, aiding bridge foundation design.
map.独立基础尺寸试算：输入上部轴力与地基承载力特征值，估算所需基底面积，再按偏心复核: Isolated foundation sizing trial: enter upper axial force and characteristic foundation bearing capacity, estimate required base area, then check by eccentricity whether base pressure exceeds 1.2 times the characteristic value.
map.软弱地基处理比选：当原状土承载力不足时，比较换填、桩基与复合地基的方案工程量，结: Weak foundation treatment comparison: when in-situ soil bearing is insufficient, compare engineering quantities of replacement, piling and composite foundation, choosing economical treatment depth by cost.
map.既有建筑增层核算：改造项目用现有基底面积反算可承受轴力，判断能否直接增层或需加固: Existing building add-story check: for renovation, back-calculate bearable axial force from current base area, judge whether to add stories directly or reinforce the foundation.
map.：上部轴力 2000 kN、地基承载力特征值 180 kPa、基础埋深 1.5: : upper axial force 2000 kN, characteristic foundation bearing 180 kPa, foundation depth 1.5 m, soil unit weight 18 kN/m3: required base area A ~ 2000/(180 - 1.5*18) ~ 12.8 m2 (about 3.6 m x 3.6 m). Increasing bearing capacity shrinks area.
map.地基承载力特征值从哪里来？: Where does the characteristic value of foundation bearing capacity come from?
map.由岩土工程勘察报告通过载荷试验或经验公式给出，需考虑深度与宽度修正；本工具输入的: Given by geotechnical investigation report via load test or empirical formula, with depth and width corrections; the input should be the corrected design value, strict prohibition of directly applying raw data.
map.偏心荷载下如何验算？: How to check under eccentric load?
map.偏心时基底出现梯形/三角形压力分布，最大压力 pmax 应 ≤1.2fa 且平均: Under eccentric load the base shows trapezoidal/triangular pressure distribution; max pressure pmax should be <=1.2fa and average pressure <=fa; the axial formula here is only a preliminary estimate; eccentric cases require the combined formula with bending moment.
map.结果能直接用于基础施工图吗？: Can results be used directly for foundation construction drawings?
map.基础设计还涉及沉降、抗震与构造配筋，须按 GB 50007 与勘察报告由注册工程: Foundation design also involves settlement, seismic resistance and structural reinforcement, to be completed by a registered engineer per GB 50007 and the survey report; this tool's results are for scheme comparison and preliminary sizing.
